races.paceDynamic: Alobayyah is the sole confirmed front runner and will likely get an uncontested lead in the early stages. Five horses (Deedaydiva, Electrifarhh, Quamby, Radiant Beauty, Song N Dance) all want prominent positions, creating significant congestion and traffic problems 2-3 furlongs out as they bunch up behind the leader. The hold-up quartet (Zgharta, Jannas Journey, Bella Perla, Politely) will need clear runs late but may struggle if the pace collapses. This race shape strongly favours front runners and those who can secure clean prominent positions early, as the traffic behind will be messy.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Alobayyah gets soft fractions up front without pressure from the prominent pack
scenarios.body: The lone leader kicks clear turning for home while the prominent bunch gets tangled up behind, giving the front runner an unassailable advantage. Clean sectionals favor the pace-setter who has saved energy for a sustained finish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Traffic Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the five prominent runners create a messy scramble 2-3 furlongs out while challenging Alobayyah
scenarios.body: The early positioning battle compromises several runners, allowing one prominent horse with the best trip to emerge, while hold-up horses benefit from the pace collapse. Late runners get their chance as the pace crumbles.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Pounce
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent congestion creates a stop-start pace that suits patient types
scenarios.body: The messy early pace sets up perfectly for Zgharta and Bella Perla to unleash finishing kicks, while the early pace setters have used up their energy in traffic. Class tells when the race opens up late.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Meltdown Benefits Outsider
scenarios.trigger: If pace collapses completely and the race becomes a sprint from 2f out
scenarios.body: None of the fancied runners get their ideal trip, creating chaos that allows an unconsidered runner to steal through for a surprise result. The race becomes a lottery when tactics go wrong.

races.paceDynamic: Golden Mind stands as the sole confirmed front runner in this 29-runner field, meaning he can dictate terms without early pressure and set a sustainable gallop. Ten Pounds, Great Acclaim, Khafiz and several others will track prominently but none are aggressive early pace-forcers. With most of the field comprised of hold-up horses including The Wizard Of Eye, Defence Minister, Mudbir and Hickory, the race will develop into a tactical affair with a moderate early pace before a frantic finish. This pace scenario strongly favours prominent racers and those with tactical speed who can position close enough to strike, rather than the pure hold-up horses who will face a wall of traffic in the sprint home.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Golden Mind gallop
scenarios.trigger: If Golden Mind gets an uncontested lead and sets steady fractions through the early stages
scenarios.body: The pace will be manageable early allowing him to kick clear, while the prominent trackers get first run on the large field of hold-up horses who struggle for racing room. Golden Mind's stamina kicks in as others flounder in traffic.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent trackers pounce
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is genuine enough to stretch Golden Mind but the prominent horses get ideal positioning behind him
scenarios.body: The likes of Ten Pounds, Great Acclaim and Khafiz get the perfect trip tracking the leader before swooping past a tiring Golden Mind in the final furlong. Hold-up horses still struggle with the numbers game in a large field.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-up heroes find gaps
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and the field comes to the boil very late with gaps appearing
scenarios.body: The class horses with finishing kicks like Defence Minister, Mudbir and The Wizard Of Eye get the splits they need to unleash their speed. But this requires perfect timing and luck in running that's hard to find.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos sprint finish
scenarios.trigger: If Golden Mind stops quickly and the prominent horses also empty, creating a blanket finish
scenarios.body: Complete mayhem ensues with any horse getting a clear run capable of winning, favouring those drawn well or with aggressive jockeys. Form goes out the window in a cavalry charge to the line.

watchPoints.text: Golden Mind must be allowed to stride clear early - if pressured for the lead by any prominent runner, his stamina advantage disappears
The draw and early positioning will be crucial - watch how the prominent horses Ten Pounds, Great Acclaim, and Khafiz settle behind Golden Mind
Monitor the pace through the first half-mile - if it's too slow, the hold-up horses like Defence Minister and Mudbir become live chances
Traffic problems are inevitable with 29 runners - any hold-up horse getting badly hampered early will struggle to recover
Watch for Morte Point and Storm Free to be ridden more aggressively than usual to avoid the crush behind

races.paceDynamic: Gordon Grey stands alone as the confirmed front runner and will set a sustainable tempo without early pressure. Behind him, six horses (Boatswain, Kirchner, Valedictory, Serenity Blue, Whatsgoingonmarvin, Al Wasl Storm) want prominent positions, creating congestion and traffic problems turning for home. The large hold-up contingent (Bulletin, Classical Allusion, Too Soon, Siempre Arturo, Wine Dark Sea, In The Breeze, Opportunity) will be relying on gaps appearing in the straight. This race shape strongly favours the lone leader Gordon Grey and any prominent runners who can secure clean racing room early.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Gordon Grey Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Gordon Grey maintains his usual front-running tactics without being challenged early
scenarios.body: The uncontested leader builds a decisive advantage while the prominent brigade gets tangled up behind, leaving the hold-up horses too much to do despite the strong pace. Gordon Grey's proven front-running record at the trip makes him the primary beneficiary.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Traffic Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the six prominent runners create severe interference turning for home
scenarios.body: The pace becomes messy as runners jostle for position, allowing a hold-up horse with Oisin Murphy's skill to weave through for Classical Allusion or Opportunity to strike late. Clean runs become crucial in a bunched finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Early Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Gordon Grey goes too slow early and gets swamped by the prominent pack
scenarios.body: Valedictory or Al Wasl Storm take control from the crowded prominent positions, while the patient hold-up horses still have too much ground to make up. The race becomes a sprint between those who positioned well mid-race.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Hero Surge
scenarios.trigger: If gaps open perfectly in the straight for the back markers
scenarios.body: Too Soon or Siempre Arturo time their runs to perfection, benefiting from the strong early pace set by Gordon Grey and the prominent congestion ahead. Requires significant pace bias and perfect positioning.

races.paceDynamic: Sintra will take this race up from the outset with no obvious challengers for the early lead, creating a comfortable tempo over the first half of this 1m2f contest. The four hold-up horses - Enemy Agent, Sassicaia, Waterford Castle and Devil's Peak - will settle behind in a cluster, meaning Sintra can dictate fractions without pressure until the home turn. This setup creates a tactical race where the pace will likely quicken from 3f out as the hold-up brigade make their moves simultaneously. The race shape strongly favours front-running tactics, as Sintra can control the tempo and kick when it suits, while the hold-up horses face the difficult task of timing their runs perfectly in a bunched finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sintra Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Sintra establishes an uncontested lead and maintains strong fractions without folding
scenarios.body: The lone front-runner dictates ideal splits and has enough left to resist late challenges, benefiting from the tactical advantage of controlling when the race begins in earnest. The hold-up quartet arrive too late having given Sintra too much rope in the early stages.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Strong Late Kick
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely run from 4f out with multiple hold-up horses making their moves
scenarios.body: Waterford Castle and Devil's Peak time their challenges perfectly as Sintra begins to tire, with the consistently placed Waterford Castle proving strongest in a driving finish. The increased tempo suits horses with proven finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Crawling Pace Backfires
scenarios.trigger: If Sintra goes too slow early and the hold-up horses get perfect trips tracking the leader
scenarios.body: Enemy Agent and Sassicaia benefit from an overly sedate tempo that plays into their hands, with both getting ideal positions to unleash late runs. The tactical disadvantage shifts dramatically when the pace collapses.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy Tactical Affair
scenarios.trigger: If the hold-up horses interfere with each other's runs and get bunched up turning for home
scenarios.body: Sintra maintains his advantage as the chasers struggle for racing room, with Devil's Peak finding the clearest passage of the hold-up horses. Traffic problems behind suit the leader who can extend his advantage when it matters most.

races.paceDynamic: Tryst, Venetia, and Nanino Niyati will ensure a strong gallop from the outset, with all three having confirmed leading tendencies and no other natural pace in this field. This sustained tempo will stretch the field and test stamina reserves over the 1m2f trip. The hold-up horses like Bint Kilfrush, Lady Ridgewood, Ruby Wedding, and Room Fourteen will have their work cut out trying to pick up the pieces. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers who can track the pace without getting embroiled in the early battle, giving them the tactical edge to strike when the leaders weaken.

scenarios.label: A

scenarios.trigger: If the three leaders maintain a genuine gallop without one dropping back early
scenarios.body: The sustained pace will anchor the front three while prominent racers can position perfectly to pounce. Naga and Moon Angel are ideally placed to capitalise when the pace takes its toll.

scenarios.label: B

scenarios.trigger: If one of the three leaders can maintain their position while the other two weaken
scenarios.body: Despite the pace pressure, the survivor benefits from having the rail and momentum when rivals tire. Tryst looks the most likely to cope with Billy Loughnane's tactical nous.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Brigade Profits
scenarios.trigger: If the three leaders go too fast and collapse dramatically in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The strong early gallop sets up a perfect scenario for closers to sweep past tired leaders. Room Fourteen and Bint Kilfrush have the class to take advantage.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If two of the three leaders drop back unexpectedly, leaving just one in front
scenarios.body: Without sufficient pace pressure, the race becomes tactical and suits horses that can quicken. This scenario favours the class horses regardless of running style.
